introHtml: Relaxed fit workwear provides extra room through the chest, shoulders, and waist, making it a practical choice for crews who need freedom of movement on the job. Whether you are outfitting a construction team with custom Safety Tees or adding logos to Carhartt Duck Vests, this cut accommodates layering and active work without binding. It also fits a wider range of body types, simplifying sizing for uniform programs. Choose relaxed fit for comfort that lasts through long shifts.
